# NeedAWebsite
 
> NeedAWebsite is a Mumbai-based web design and development studio run by founder Tabish. It builds fast, mobile-friendly websites for small businesses across India, set up to be found on Google and recommended by AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Perplexity (SEO, AEO and GEO).
 
Work is done remotely over calls, WhatsApp and email. Clients deal directly with the founder, who brings in specialists (content writers, graphic designers, backend engineers) when a project needs them. A written quote is given before any work starts.
 
## Key pages
- [Home](https://needawebsite.in/): Overview of services, how the process works, proof of work and FAQs
- [One Page Website for ₹1,499](https://needawebsite.in/websitefor1499/): Fixed-price offer with what is included, what is not, pricing and FAQs
- [Services](https://needawebsite.in/services/): Web design and development, AI search optimization, custom web apps and dashboards
- [Creative](https://needawebsite.in/creative/): Interactive web experiences, 3D and animation demos, and the NeedAWebsite design process
- [About](https://needawebsite.in/about/): About the founder, Tabish
- [Contact](https://needawebsite.in/contact/): Free quote form, phone and WhatsApp
 
## Offer: one-page website for ₹1,499
- Price: ₹1,499, including the first year of hosting
- Delivery: within 48 hours
- Included: custom-designed one page website, mobile-friendly design, basic SEO setup, 1 year of hosting, SSL certificate and security, WhatsApp chat button, contact form, Google Maps, social media integration, analytics, Google Business Profile setup, and one round of revisions
- Renewal: hosting renews at ₹1,999 per year from the second year
- Domain name: not included; bought and owned by the client
- Not included: extra pages, online selling (e-commerce) and anything not listed above. Design updates later are quoted separately.
- Suitable for: gyms, pilates studios, salons, beauty parlours, restaurants, cafes, clinics, dentists, coaches, tutors, freelancers, boutiques and other small businesses
 
## Other services
- Multi-page websites, online stores and custom web apps: typically 4 to 8 weeks depending on size and complexity, with a written quote first
- AI search optimization: structuring a website so Google and AI assistants can understand and recommend the business
- After launch: edits, updates and ranking support are available
- No specific search ranking is guaranteed
 
## Tools and proof
- [AI Visibility Scanner](https://aiscan.needawebsite.in): Free tool that checks how easily search engines and AI assistants can read and understand a website
- [Nourish by Neelam](https://nourishbyneelam.com): Case study, a clinical and sports nutrition practice with a full SEO, AEO and GEO foundation
